en: The image is a colored vintage postcard showing a wide view of a coastal fortification with classical architecture, with a rocky hill rising behind it and a cross atop the summit. There is a calm bay, a few boats (including a prominent sailboat), and some buildings with tiled roofs in the foreground. The postcard is labeled 'Corfou - Citadelle (côté nord.)' at the top left, and there is a visible postmark/stamp.
